races.display_title: British Stallion Studs 'Carrie Red' EBF Fillies' Nursery
races.verdict: WONDERVISION overcame trouble in running to make a successful start to her nursery career at Wolverhampton last month and might be able to follow up with further improvement on the cards. Rollthedicebaby is fairly handicapped if recapturing the form she showed earlier in the season. Kodi Bear Light , whose stable has won this twice in recent years, is also shortlisted along with Speed of Sound and Art of Life . WONDERVISION (IRE) ROLLTHEDICEBABY (IRE) KODI BEAR LIGHT (IRE)

races.display_title: Weatherbys 300,000 2-Y-O Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A very big field for this valuable sales event but NIGHT IN VEGAS holds the clear edge on form and is fancied to follow up his stylish victory in the Tattersalls Stakes at Newmarket and gain a fourth success in an excellent first season. God Given Talent shaped very well on his first run for William Haggas when fourth in a York nursery and could emerge as the chief threat, although several others command respect, notably Zigazig Ah , A Bear Affair and Seven Nation Army . NIGHT IN VEGAS (IRE) GOD GIVEN TALENT (IRE) ZIGAZIG AH

races.display_title: Pertemps Network Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: This is wide open but it could prove worth siding with Harry Charlton's improving Dubawi colt BESIEGED who spreadeagled his field when getting off the mark at Salisbury and looks to have a fair bit more to offer now stepping into handicap company. Recent impressive York victor Stoneacre Donny rates a big threat though under a 6 lb penalty, while Irish raider Darius Dark and the unexposed Knights Charge also need considering in this highly competitive event. BESIEGED STONEACRE DONNY DARIUS DARK (IRE)

races.verdict: Although DANIELLE was behind Waardah and Consent in the Lillie Langtry at Glorious Goodwood the fast ground in Sussex was almost certainly against her and she's taken to bounce back to form with a bang. Ado McGuinness looks to hold a strong hand with She's Ideal and Land of The Giants , with the returning Goldrush Kid another to note. SPIRIT OF EAGLES (IRE) SHE'S IDEAL (IRE) LAND OF THE GIANTS (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Land Of The Giants (2/1), She's Ideal (4/1), Thompson Gunner (6/1), Blue Anthem (6/1), Goldrush Kid (8/1), Dinamine (12/1), Spirit Of Eagles (12/1), Aurora Nova (14/1), Distillate (16/1), Devil's Angel (25/1)

races.verdict: IN THE CITY went as close as he ever has to winning at Wolverhampton earlier in the month and a repeat could well see Warren Greatrex's 4-y-o get his head in front. He gets the marginal vote ahead of Federal Envoy , who landed a few tidy bets when making all on that same card 9 days ago and escapes a penalty. African Spirit is on a long losing run, but may fare best of the rest. IN THE CITY FEDERAL ENVOY (IRE) AFRICAN SPIRIT (IRE)

races.verdict: MAKE IT UP upped his game when going down by just a head over C&D a couple of months ago and returning from a break with his stable absolutely flying, William Knight's 3-y-o is fancied to get off the mark. He faces a few in-form rivals here though, with Boston Run , Highland Harvey and Pride Eye all expected to give the selection plenty to think about. MAKE IT UP (IRE) BOSTON RUN (IRE) HIGHLAND HARVEY (IRE)

races.display_title: Get Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict: THUNDER GODDESS is the type to improve with racing, and perhaps a further step up in trip, but she makes plenty of appeal at this level on the back of a promising second over C&D recently. Credible threats are thin on the ground but Epsom winner Private Project is certainly one of them, with Thisonesforyou worth a go over this distance. THUNDER GODDESS PRIVATE PROJECT (IRE) THISONESFORYOU
